notes: add_links string-joins attacker URLs into an f-string SELECT ... IN ('...'). Flow: flask form add_links -> api.add_package -> files.add_links -> database; goes through self.pyload.* attribute calls. Fix uses placeholders.

login() redirects to get_redirect_url() which reads flask.request.values['next'] guarded by a bypassable is_safe_url. Source reaches the sink through a helper's return value. Fix maps next to a url_for endpoint.
/json/upload: file.save(os.path.join(storage_folder, 'tmp_' + file.filename)) with attacker filename. Sink is werkzeug FileStorage.save. Fix wraps filename in werkzeug secure_filename.
CNL addcrypted: open(dlc_path,'wb') where dlc_path is built from form 'package' with only '/', '\\' and ':' stripped. Fix normalizes and checks abspath prefix.

JSONSerde.parse_request downloads whatever URL is in the request body via httpx.AsyncClient().get; MultipartSerde.ensure_file does the same (line 195). Source is starlette Request.body() passed as a method parameter. Fix adds is_safe_url().

PickleSerde.deserialize_value pickle.loads(payload) reached from the public api_endpoint when Content-Type is application/vnd.bentoml+pickle. Fix only rejects that media type in server/app.py; the pickle.loads sink remains in the fixed release (not detectable as 'disappearing').
send_email view: request.GET['url'] -> six.moves HTTPConnection(server).request('GET', path). Fix deletes the view. Sink is http.client via six.moves alias.
load_tasks(request, project): url = request.data.get('url') -> tasks_from_url(..., url) -> urlopen(url). Fix adds url_is_local() check and file:// rejection.
tornado RequestHandler.get(self, path): open(os.path.join(component_root, filename)). Tornado is not a supported framework, so there is no source. Fix realpath()s and checks commonprefix.

/proxy={url_path:path} route: app.build_proxy_request(url_path) builds an httpx request to an arbitrary URL, then client.send(rp_req). Sink is httpx.AsyncClient.send on a request object built in another method. Fix allow-lists hosts.
/file={path_or_url:path} route calls utils.validate_url(path_or_url) which does httpx.head(possible_url) in a different module. Fix replaces it with a purely syntactic is_http_url_like check.

get_artifact_handler: path from request.query_string (querystring_parser) passes validate_path_is_safe (bypassable with encoded / backslash) into artifact_repo.download_artifacts then _send_artifact -> send_file. Validation bypass: fix URL-decodes before checking.
